number_of_biological_replicates: To analyze the proteome content of MSC derived EVs, EV pellets from WT, NTC and TSG-6 MSCs were collected as described above and resuspended in 100 µl PBS (n = 3).
technology_type: The Orbitrap Astral was operated in data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode, with MS1 scans conducted in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 240,000 and a maximum injection time of 5 ms across a range of 380–980 m/z.
